name: Greater Mark Of Finding
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Mark of Finding Feat) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Improved Intuition
features.description: When you use the Hunter’s Intuition benefit of your Mark of Finding feat, you can roll 1d6 instead of 1d4.

features.name: Improved Finding
features.description: When you use the Finder’s Magic benefit of your Mark of Finding to cast Hunter’s Mark without a spell slot, the range of the spell is doubled, and you can modify the spell so that the target can’t benefit from the Invisible condition for the duration.
